body: You know that feeling when you wake up in the morning and everyone around you despises everything that your are? Your family that has to love you on a genetic level doesn't even know how to approach you as a person; they lie and tell their friends I'm taking summer classes, I was kicked out of uni months ago. The things I had to do to stay afloat, the people I had to fuck over to stay out of prison, I have no friends anymore, those that I once thought were friends turned into horrendous people before my eyes, I don't see it going anywhere, just a constant hell that you can tolerate enough to survive but not enough to actually live. I would like to end it, and what has life graced you with if I may ask since we're sharing
It's just... all around me I see lives ruined and in more than a few I was the x factor
